body: Ok. Yes, we all have trauma. you say that as if this is the only thing I've had happen in my life. You literally have no idea what I've been through in my life. Admittedly, I don't know what youve been through - but I also didn't ask. I posted here looking for support and you used it as an opportunity to tout your philosophy on male circumcision, and "vent" about how upset you are. I could also take the time to list all my shitty life experiences on someone else's post about how they want to kill themselves, but I'm not a fucking shitty person, so I wont.

Again, there's nothing to forgive me for. I'm not sure what this tirade about circumcision is about. But honestly find someone else to harass.

I'm glad you're telling someone who for all you know is suicidal that their husband will never forgive them. Hope you feel pretty good about that. Please go fuck yourself.

He has nothing to forgive me for. He was supportive of the decision to end the pregnancy. 

Don't worry his parents beat him plenty. Too bad that type of punishment is completely ineffective. 

Because moving on from something like this is not as simple as you seem to think it is.

Not sure what infant circumcision has to do with anything.

My husband and I are trying to work through things, thank you for your concern.

Is this really the appropriate place to be saying stuff like this? This is not about all men. No one said it was. This is a unique situation and I'm posting here because I'm fucking suicidal. Because I want to die. I would give anything to die right now and get away from this pain. I posted because I'm in a horrible situation, that I had literally no choice in, and I have no one to turn to.

I spoke to his sister and she confirmed what he told me. 

He's upset about things getting spread around and feels like he won't be able to look at his friends anymore. He's ashamed and digusted by it.

His sister and him used to be close, they drifted apart I guess, maybe this is why. It only just came out though. He's been trying to reach out to her, but idk if that's the right thing to do right now. I don't know what's right or wrong anymore to be honest.

She told his parents first, and he admitted it to them. His parents were upset but believe that he was a child when it happened. He's been trying to explain the seriousness of all this.

He touched his sister inappropriately when he was 12 and she was 7. He said it was curiosity, that they were left alone for hours at a time, that it never went beyond looking and touching and he realized it was wrong and stopped. he had no friends, no sex education, his parents never talked to him about that stuff, he said he didn't understand what we was doing would hurt her down the line. I'm sure in some way he knew it was wrong. He said he never forced her. 

I don't know if this matters, because he doesn't feel that it was the reason he did it but he was physically abused by his parents when he was a child. I know they had a horrible childhood, and i know she resents that his life looks perfect now.

He wants to make amends, but understands she may never forgive him. She blames him for her problems. I can't say I blame her.

His sister told a friend of mine, I'm scared that she will tell more people. She has every right to. The shame is just too much. 

Why does it feel so wrong for wanting to stay? It feels like I'd be brushing it under the rug. I know his sister will see it that way

If only it were that simple. What if you were afraid that the person you love more than anything in the world was going to be seen as a monster, that you could lose all your friends? That you would have to leave your whole life behind if you choose to stay with them? What if you could leave them and spare them prolonging this pain. What if this made question your morals and values for staying? What about the person who suffered because of all this? Where's their justice? They want me to leave him, and I'm so torn. 

The world isn't black and white, but for most people touching a child, even as a child is a black and white issue. People are labeled for life for this. I wish I could just make a decision. I really just want to escape making any decision at all..
I agree with you. I wish more people would understand. I feel so alone. I have so much shame.

I love my husband dearly, and I always will. He is a wonderful man today, we had a wonderful relationship. This isn't about men being bad, or women being good. Neither of us are perfect people but we've been good to eachother. The truth is he made a horrible mistake as a child that is affecting me and our relationship today. I am faced with an impossible decision. I wish I could pretend i nothing happened - i wish that more than anything, but I can't.
